command_results_coverage: Every results row of every run was read. The P11 driver writes DRY rows only in DRY mode, a wait:<label> INCOMPLETE row for each failed wait, and exits 1 on any FAIL/INCOMPLETE row.
residuals: Go deadline timers (internal/host/host.go:370, frozen) set no AccuracySec, so systemd may fire them up to 60 s late. The L2 settle wait (240 s) and the L6 window (deadline 2 min inside a 185 s window) allow for it, but L6 has only 5 s margin at the worst case. The wall timer itself uses AccuracySec=1s.

The witnesses use stub transport and stub agent-loop for effects; real systemd was used only for the driver's own transient scope and wall timer. Real agent-loop units are exercised only in the signed live run.
Cleanup's agent-deck session stop/remove calls pass no profile (inherited from P10, outside F1-F3).

The P10 F2 reproduction ran the P10 wall with the host's real PATH (P10 does not pass PATH): it ran a real 'systemctl --user daemon-reload', reset-failed/stop on nonexistent fxW081630 units, and agent-deck stop/remove of nonexistent sessions W1/V1/D1/U1 (all 'not found'). No real unit or seat was affected.

Two superseded early witness runs wrote wall evidence into this package (live-W081040, live-W081159) before EV_DIR was passed to the wall; they were moved to /tmp. The first run also showed the default 1-min timer accuracy (wall fired 30 s late), which led to AccuracySec=1s.
EV_DIR is passed to the wall only when set (offline rehearsal hook, as in P10).
